title: The fireball execution — one of 33 ways a mill ends in Millfall
text: Pixel-art Nine Men's Morris where every closed mill triggers an execution. This one is the mage's fireball, mid-flight in the Ember Forge arena.

title: The polymorph execution — the loser hops off the board and lives at the pond forever
text: One of 33 execution animations in Millfall, a pixel-art Nine Men's Morris. Close a mill and your mage does the rest — the arenas remember every fallen piece.
